mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing partly cloudy skies and 69 degrees near the Verona Area High School, with a third quarter moon visible tonight.
In city news, the Verona Senior Center is inviting residents to enjoy the outdoors with their tri-shaw bike program, and the Recreation Department is currently hiring for adult fitness instructors.
There is plenty to do with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Dane County Farmers' Market on the square happens tomorrow.
Regarding local public safety, on July 28, an officer located an occupied vehicle in Fireman's Park after hours, resulting in a man being taken into custody for an outstanding arrest warrant.
The flavor of the day is the decadent Really Reese's. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, while tomorrow you can look forward to the Andes Mint Avalanche.
